Original publisher reference image cropped at original pixel edges and masked at pixel centres; no reclassification, no area calculation. Transparent pixels have no forest assertion.

limitations: Crop and livestock native resolution is 5 arc-min, about 7–9 km in Japan; display pixels are not observation resolution.
Crop quantity is modeled harvested area, not crop-field boundaries or physical agricultural land area.
Pig density is modeled heads per km², not pork production. Cattle data are not substituted for separate dairy/beef.
JRC forest is a coarse publisher image reference, not a detailed native forest classification or complete small-island inventory.
